titles.title: Untitled (Abstraction Green Line and Red Circle)

credit_line: Gift of The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation
description: Vertical abstract depiction of beige field; in the center a wide green wash, fading lighter toward the bottom; a red circle in approximately the middle of the green field, darker red on the bottom 2/3, lighter red upper 1/3.
